# Stage 25 Frontier Ledger

## Proved composition law

Positivity gives

```text
K <= exp(ell) K0,  K0 V <= kV,  RV <= rV
       => (K+R)V <= (exp(ell)k+r)V.
```

|---|---:|

| reference ceiling | `0.00121510958676` |

## Open

The result is a positive-kernel theorem and a feasible numerical budget, not
a construction of the complete nonlinear `SU(2)` subkernels.  The residual
weighted partition numerator is the first physical analytic input still
missing.  Strongest level: `C2` theorem plus `C1` calibration.
